text:
# Close wrap, Fri 2026-11-13

**Indexes:** S&P 500 −0.4% (7,560.87 prelim), Nasdaq −0.9% (25,135.96), Dow +0.1% (52,343.23). The S&P snapped a four-week losing streak with a weekly gain of about 2.5% ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-us-oil-f8edd0eeb1494d4d2584715686c5e619); [Reuters](https://financialnewsletter.com/sp-500-nasdaq-end-25/)).
**Why:** Tech was the worst sector. NVDA fell for a sixth straight week after Huang's exit and closed below a $4T market cap. AMD and AVGO were the biggest drags on SOX, and CRWV, NBIS, IREN, and APLD all fell. MSFT recovered from its outage to finish green. The 10-yr hit 5.17% intraday ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-november-13-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-ppi-141451558.html)).
**Macro:** October PPI was +0.3% m/m (est. +0.4%) with core +0.3% in line, but +6.5% y/y is the highest since Nov 2022. A December hike is still fully priced ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/ppi-inflation-report-october-2026.html)).
**Covered names:** CSCO fell 6.2% to $95.64 despite its raised guide, so the conditional idea is void ([CNBC movers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)). PANW gave back its KeyBanc pop and closed at $322.24, down 0.1%. AAPL hit a record on safe-haven buying. Among gappers, MOD rose ~25% on Samsung takeover talk and CBRS ~16%, both skipped under the gap rule. Light after-hours calendar.
**Setup:** Next week brings HD/DIS 11/17, NVDA 11/17 AMC, TJX/LOW/TGT 11/18, PANW 11/18 AMC, and WMT/INTU 11/19. The AI-hardware group avoid (now including CSCO) stays through 11/18.

**Scorecard (week of 11/9):** 1 up, 3 down, 1 void. New calls averaged −0.7% vs SPY +0.0% over the same windows. Last week's beat-and-raise holds: HUM +8.4%, PLNT +5.4%, CPAY +3.4%, CAH +2.4%, ABNB −1.7%. Paper swing book −0.4% on the week vs bench +2.6%.

**Swing idea:**
- **STE**: Jefferies upgraded it to Buy with a $305 PT, calling it a steady double-digit EPS grower at a compressed multiple. It was up nearly 4% (CNBC). Confidence: low. Key risk: the catalyst is an upgrade only, the stock may fail the 1M-share volume filter, and rates are above 5.1%.

_Fri extras: AI watch found nothing that qualified (one skip logged). Strategy lab has no new hypothesis this week (EAR drift was considered and rejected). Lessons rewritten._
